nodes.text: 1  Air comes in through the trachea, held open by rings of cartilage
2  At the carina it splits into the right and left main bronchi
3  The bronchi branch about 23 times, into every lobe: three on the right, two on the left
4  At the tips, 300 million tiny air sacs pass oxygen into the blood
5  The pulmonary arteries bring oxygen-poor blood in; the veins carry it back to the heart

widgets.text: A real adult pair of lungs from anatomical scans, shown with the airways and blood vessels inside. The right lung has three lobes and the left two, leaving room for the heart. Together they hold about 6 litres of air. Cut them open, X-ray them, or separate the lobes.
